items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: he drove back to John Hopkins to see if he could straighten out, or something.

ctx.x: Somebody had took something out of that spine or did something to it. When we went in the Paramount Theater, and whatever happened, that hard work at the Paramount Theater brought on that illness -- did something.
It caused his death, because right after that, when we got to Washington, he drove back to John Hopkins to see if he could straighten out, or something.
